reviews.title: Clean Look, Great Airflow
reviews.comment: Super clean and modern design. The mesh front gives great airflow, and the white finish looks amazing in a minimalist setup. Plenty of room for cable management and parts, and the case feels solid overall. If you care about both performance and aesthetics, this case is a great choice.
reviews.author: ebrima

reviews.title: Awesome case, very roomy, very quiet.
reviews.comment:
The case came with standoffs in the AXT configuration. There is a lot of room here as well as a hdd case for hard drives. Additionally: it has a unique setup for up to 3 SSD drives. You could easily fit 5 drives in here (2 hdd, 3 ssd). The drives are hidden behind a little wall. The included 3 front fans are nearly silent. I sit right next to my computer and I can't hear  them when I'm doing normal pc tasks. During gaming it's still pretty quiet. It's very easy to put together and has a dust filter on the front, top and power supply.
I love this case. Great cooling, included fans, ARBG controller. USB-C & USB-A connectors. It has everything.
reviews.author: Azphxguy

reviews.title: Excellent case, Very Adaptable, Good Cable Management System
reviews.comment: I absolutely Love this case . It is very well priced and still provides you with a ton of features and great build quality. This case is so well designed that doesn't force you to make compromises on what hardware to use all while looking Really Good. I've changed my set up which you can see from the pics, from a Noctua D15 Double Tower cooler, To an Arctic Liquid Freezer ll 280 AIO,  and then adding a Vertical GPU Mounting System inside it. Good Job Cooler Master!!!!  This is a Great Case To Build In!!!!!

reviews.title: What an improvement over the Masterbox
reviews.comment:
Replaced the most budget coolermaster case of the last decade (masterbox code name master
-oven v1) and my temps have never been so good.
The mesh front really picks up lots of airflow; stock fans have pretty ARGB but they are NOT the HALO style with the outer LED band, that was my own mistake though.
The lighting effect is very smooth on AuraSync when set properly; I like the dynamic mode so it matches what’s on screen currently.
